content.title: Soft G vs. Hard G 😀💬 - English Pronunciation
content.text: Billie English – your go-to YouTube channel for perfecting your English pronunciation, improving fluency, and reducing your first language accent! 👉 WHAT THIS VIDEO IS ABOUT English pronunciation can be confusing, especially when the letter G has two different sounds! Do you know when to pronounce G as /dʒ/ (like "giraffe") and when to say /g/ (like "goat")? Understanding this rule will instantly improve your pronunciation and confidence. 📌 In this video, you'll learn: ✅ The rule for soft G (/dʒ/) and hard G (/g/) ✅ Common examples to practice both sounds ✅ A special 8-word pronunciation test—Can you get them all right? 🎥 Watch now and put your skills to the test!
